solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: In spite of that Mr Perrin shortly has a way with Lesley South

parts.note: Reginald Perrin, the TV sitcom hero, cut short to his everyday name Reg
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
Les is the short form of the name Lesley

explanation.surface: Someone named Mr Perrin gets his own way with a woman called Lesley South, whatever happens.
explanation.walkthrough: Reginald Perrin was the hero of a 1970s British TV comedy about a man in a midlife crisis.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are adverbial phrases meaning nevertheless, paying no heed to what has been said.

clue.text: Rogue sailor changed sides

indicators.note: the clue's 'changed' says the letters standing for left and right are exchanged here
the clue's 'sides' points to the two letters for the left and right sides, which swap places

parts.note: a lascar is an East Indian seaman

explanation.surface: A treacherous sailor deserts to the enemy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Changed sides' means L (left) and R (right) trade places in LASCAR: the opening L becomes R and the closing R becomes L.
explanation.definitionFit: A rogue is a mischievous scoundrel, a simple synonym.

clue.text: Prisoner turned up with old books, clumsy fellow

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning the word upwards reads it backwards

parts.note: a lag is slang for a convict, especially an old lag
OT is the Old Testament, a collection of books

explanation.surface: A prisoner shows up carrying ancient volumes, the awkward oaf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned up' looks like arrived; in a down entry it reverses LAG to GAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A galoot is an informal word for an awkward, oafish man.

clue.text: Setting right notice that had been included when attending to problem again

indicators.note: the notice is placed within the other word, so it is included in it

parts.note: redressing means putting right a wrong
an ad is a notice in a newspaper

explanation.surface: Correcting a notice that was put in while dealing with a problem once more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Included' puts the notice inside the word for setting right, just after its first two letters; 'that had been' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To address an issue is to deal with it; doing that a second time is re-addressing it.

clue.text: Collie fetched contents willingly

indicators.note: the answer is what the two words contain, running across the join between them

explanation.surface: A sheepdog brought back what was inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Lief is an old adverb meaning gladly, as in 'I would as lief stay'.

clue.text: Right way to look at allusion?

definitions.meaning: a quick glance to one side, such as the right
a passing indirect reference to something

explanation.surface: Is there a correct way to view a reference?
explanation.definitionFit: A sidelong look is literally a glance aside; figuratively it is a brief oblique mention.

clue.text: Shantytown problem inexperienced driver included

indicators.note: the learner letter sits inside the other piece, so it is included

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem
L is the learner plate of a novice driver

explanation.surface: A shantytown has a problem with a learner driver within it.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a learner driver displays an L plate.
explanation.definitionFit: A shantytown is a squalid, overcrowded district, which is a synonym.

clue.text: Some applaud a number a number

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people clap for a song or two.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'a number' is the definition: read it as 'a numb-er', something that numbs.
explanation.definitionFit: Laudanum, an opium tincture, deadens pain, so it is something that numbs: a 'numb-er'.

clue.text: Horse at home going round a wild Irish pasture

indicators.note: the two pieces go round the letter A, enclosing it

parts.note: a mount is a horse for riding
in means at home

explanation.surface: A horse, back home, goes round a stretch of rough Irish grazing.
explanation.definitionFit: In Ireland the word for a peak is also used for rough, uncultivated grazing land.

clue.text: Serve salad that had been prepared with Italian sauce

indicators.note: the letters are made ready in a new arrangement, as food is prepared

explanation.surface: Serve a salad dressed with an Italian sauce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prepared' rearranges the letters of SERVE and SALAD.
explanation.definitionFit: This green sauce of herbs, garlic and oil is a classic Italian condiment.

clue.text: Leader took viol round ancient city

indicators.note: the instrument's letters wrap round the city's letters

parts.note: a gu, or gue, is an old Shetland stringed instrument of the viol kind
Ur is the ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A leader carried a stringed instrument around an old city.
explanation.definitionFit: A guru is a spiritual teacher, or anyone followed as a guide.

clue.text: Both comrades injured and won't fight

indicators.note: hurt and out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Two wounded comrades in arms are unable to carry on fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase describes a soldier out of action, unable to fight on.

clue.text: Not in agreement with a surgeon trapping fox

indicators.note: the outer pieces trap the fox between them

parts.note: DS stands for dental surgeon
tod is a Scots and dialect word for a fox

explanation.surface: Disagreeing with a vet who has caught a fox.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in disagreement or conflict is an idiomatic sense of the phrase.

clue.text: Blissfully unenlightened

parts.note: plays on the saying that ignorance is bliss: someone who does not know is happy

explanation.surface: Happily unaware of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking knowledge, and by the proverb 'where ignorance is bliss' happier for it.

clue.text: A disordered residence, and I court order

indicators.note: the letters are thrown out of their order

explanation.surface: A messy home, and me facing a court order.
explanation.definitionFit: A provisional divorce order granted by a court, which becomes absolute later.

clue.text: I don't know what's special in France

definitions.text: I don't know what's special in France

parts.words: I don't know what's special in France
parts.note: the French words literally mean 'I don't know what', and the phrase names an indefinable special quality

explanation.surface: Someone admits being unsure what makes France special.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase, borrowed into English, names an elusive attractive quality.

clue.text: Shooter in part or in quantity?

definitions.meaning: the wooden butt of a rifle, part of a gun
cryptically, a store of guns held in quantity

explanation.surface: Is a gun to be had singly or by the crate?
explanation.definitionFit: The butt of a firearm is one part; read as two words it is a supply of firearms.

clue.text: Drink from orange mug

parts.note: an orange is a fruit
a mug is a cup

explanation.surface: A drink served from an orange mug.
explanation.definitionFit: A fruit cup is a mixed drink, often a punch with chopped fruit.

clue.text: Accessible to all reproducing red tinctures

indicators.note: making the letters again in a different form

explanation.surface: Copies of red dyes are open to everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Without limits on who may enter or use something, so open to anyone.

clue.text: Ship in North American gold to make capital

parts.note: N for North and A for American
SS is steamship
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A ship in American gold to found a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Nassau is the capital city of the Bahamas.

clue.text: A number in southern Switzerland smell

indicators.note: the number goes in between the other two letters

parts.note: CH is the international code for Switzerland
ten is a number

explanation.surface: Several things in the south of Switzerland give off an odour.
explanation.definitionFit: A stench is a strong foul smell, a synonym.

clue.text: Frank embraced individual who was more emaciated

indicators.note: the comedian's surname holds the letter inside it

parts.note: Frank Skinner is a British comedian
I, one, is a single individual

explanation.surface: Frank hugged someone who had grown thinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank' looks like the adjective meaning candid; it is the British comedian Frank Skinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of a word for very thin, bony and wasted.

clue.text: Type of blue round object given to one officer — there's no justice

parts.note: C for circa, about, which means round

indicators.note: J is the abbreviation for Justice, a judge, and here it is taken away

parts.note: obj is the abbreviation for object
a means one
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant

explanation.surface: A round thing handed to an officer prompts a complaint that life isn't fair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Round object' tempts as COB (a rounded lump), but 'round' gives C (circa) and the short form of object loses its J (Justice), signalled by 'there's no justice'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cobalt blue is a deep blue pigment named after the metal.

clue.text: Queen had hard time

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A queen went through a difficult period.
explanation.definitionFit: Hera was queen of the Greek gods, wife of Zeus.

clue.text: Notice it leaving another formerly

indicators.note: with the two letters gone, the rest are rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: Spotting one thing departing in favour of another, as before.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaving' takes IT out of NOTICE, and 'another' rearranges the remaining NOCE.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means at some time in the past, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Is braver in converting drainage area

indicators.note: the letters are converted into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone is bolder when it comes to changing a drainage area.
explanation.definitionFit: The land drained by a river and its tributaries is its catchment, a geographical term.

clue.text: Where squirming pike might go

indicators.note: a wriggling fish suggests the letters writhing into a new order

explanation.surface: Where would a wriggling fish end up?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Squirming' rearranges PIKE; the whole clue is also the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A kipe is a wicker basket for trapping fish, so a caught fish ends up there.

clue.text: Milk maids feel it's a way to get rich

definitions.text: it's a way to get rich

indicators.note: milking works and squeezes something, so the letters are worked into a new order

parts.note: to feel is to touch

explanation.surface: Dairymaids think milking is a route to wealth.
explanation.definitionFit: King Midas turned all he touched to gold, so the phrase means a knack for making money.
